##### Project general facts

Q Gardens Lofts by AYS Developers is a contemporary residential tower that blends classic elegance with modern sophistication and a refined balance of indoor and outdoor spaces. The building rises above a basement, a ground floor with retail units and five parking levels to the residential floors and a roof. The collection offers studios, one- and two-bedroom apartments and distinctive two-, three- and four-bedroom duplex lofts with flexible, light-filled layouts and expressive double-height living spaces.

Residents enjoy a modern gym, a rooftop infinity pool with panoramic views of the city and an indoor cinema for relaxed evenings. Sports courts, children's play areas and a landscaped garden with barbecue zones create welcoming places for families, while a residents' sitting area and lounge provide calm spaces to unwind. Podium parking, round-the-clock security and concierge services add everyday comfort and peace of mind for residents and their guests.

Interiors balance space, light and function, with high-quality flooring, marble countertops and bespoke fittings selected for elegance and durability. Kitchens are equipped with a complete range of appliances, while the flexible interior spaces offer residents the freedom to infuse their personal style. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and making every loft easy to personalise.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Village Circle is a vibrant, family-friendly community at the centre of the city, known for its circular layout of landscaped parks, low- and mid-rise residential buildings and townhouses. Circle Mall, the community park network, neighbourhood cafes, supermarkets, nurseries, schools and clinics cover daily needs close to home and give the area a green, relaxed character.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Khail Road connect residents with the wider city. Dubai Marina, Business Bay and Mall of the Emirates are a short drive away, Downtown Dubai and Jumeirah Beach are close by, and Dubai International Airport and Al Maktoum International Airport are within comfortable reach for frequent travellers and commuters.

Jumeirah Village Circle is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the most popular rental markets in Dubai. A central position between the coastal districts and the inland business hubs attracts young professionals and families, supporting high occupancy and steady demand. Well-finished homes with resort-style amenities and competitive prices underpin attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners.
